cues: A reading nook often gains vertical storage for favorite titles without sacrificing much floor space.
Dust gathers along exposed ledges where paperbacks stand upright beside a reading chair.
A collection of spines can turn a plain study wall into a colorful focal point.
Children often reach lower levels for picture books while adults keep reference works above.
Literary volumes remain within view, close to a desk or comfortable armchair.
Decorative bookends keep uneven rows of novels from leaning across an open wooden frame.
